items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I had talked very long with Charlie about Clarke

ctx.x: But did you know how good Clarke was, really?

I hadn't heard him play, but I had complete faith in Charlie Shavers, and I mean, I talked a great deal -- when you go and send for a guy from St. Louis -- I had talked very long with Charlie about Clarke, and after what he said and as much faith as I had in Charlie, I had no qualms about it at all.
